survey: A cowboy hat seen in three-quarter view from above-front, floating on a blue sunburst background, which is normal for an icon. The crown is a tall leather dome with a centre crease and a front pinch at the top. It rises from the middle of the brim and joins it all the way round. A red band wraps the base of the crown in one continuous loop and sits flush where the crown meets the brim. The brim is one sheet that runs all the way round the crown and shows behind it on both sides. A cream rolled binding follows its whole edge without a break. The left side of the brim is wide and nearly flat. The right side sweeps upward and narrows to a sharp point. The front edge dips toward the camera. There are no loose straps, no stampede string and no added parts.

errors.where: Brim, right side versus left side
errors.what: The two sides of the brim do not match. A cowboy hat's brim is a roughly oval sheet, curled up about equally on both sides. Here the left side is broad, rounded and almost flat. The right side curls up and narrows into a pointed horn-like tip. Viewing angle cannot explain the difference, so the brim reads as lopsided rather than as one symmetrical oval.

fix: Make the brim a symmetrical oval round the crown, with both sides curled up equally into soft rounded rolls. Neither side should narrow to a point. Keep the cream binding running evenly along the whole edge.
